detail.why: The existing bounds test compared against the MAX_EVIDENCE_REFERENCES constant itself, so raising the constant to 100000 left it green. A bound asserted against its own constant is not a bound.
detail.fix: Added a test pinning the ceiling to the published number 20 and feeding 500 references, so moving the constant now fails.

detail.why: Same defect: compared against MAX_CRITERIA rather than a number.
detail.fix: Added a test pinning MAX_CRITERIA to 20 with 500 supplied criteria on both lists.

detail.fix: Anchor corrected; the mutant is now KILLED (1 test).

killed.criterion: a gate refusal is POLICY_BLOCKED, never DISPATCHED
dispatch is NOT inferred from a successful execution
an unobserved effect is EFFECT_UNVERIFIABLE, never verified
dispatch and effect do not collapse: no dispatch means no effect
assertTruthfulHistory refuses to emit a lying history
observation state defaults to UNKNOWN, never to OBSERVED
the egress projection is an ALLOWLIST; internal state stays local
goal status defaults to PENDING, never SATISFIED
the rendered state reports COUNTS, not raw criterion text

independentPromptScan.note: A first pass of the probe reported a 10-digit run. It came from the capture envelope (a timestamp), not from the prompt text. Re-run with the scan restricted to the exact prompt: no hits. Recorded rather than quietly dropped, because the first reading was wrong.

realChromeCheckpoint.interpretation: Two requests were accepted with HTTP 200, which means decision_state passed the backend's extra='forbid' schema — the 422 that previously blocked every A3 run is gone. The two 503s are provider rate limits, reported truthfully as rate_limit/retryable and never converted into a success. postDataBytes grows with the ledger, as expected when a bounded decision state carries up to 20 evidence references.
realChromeCheckpoint.evidenceLedgerNote: A2's cross-page accumulation is real in Chrome: records from generation N survive into generation N+1 and the ring buffer stops at its 60-record ceiling rather than growing without bound.
